headline: Bomb Threats Disrupt Passenger Flights Across Europe
summary: A wave of bomb threats has forced emergency landings and security interventions for at least 15 passenger flights across several European countries, including France, Italy, and Belgium.
why: Security disruptions in the aviation sector can lead to operational delays, increased security costs, and temporary volatility in airline stocks.
why_moved: Widespread security threats across major European transit hubs typically trigger risk-off sentiment for airline operators and travel-related stocks.
